tip: WIN — You conducted a methodical, systematic inspection that builds customer confidence. Starting outside, moving to attic, shutting down thermostats for safety—that sequence is professional and shows expertise. Your knowledge of past repairs, understanding that switches are a repeat issue, and ability to explain OEM vs aftermarket parts demonstrates deep technical credibility. The signature sheet explanation and warm goodbye acknowledging their summer travel pattern show you're paying attention to customer context. FIX — You completed a thorough inspection but didn't convert it into future revenue. After confirming everything is good, say: 'Based on your history with the switches, I'd recommend our seasonal maintenance program—four quarterly check-ups at $X per visit. With your summer travel pattern, you'll have peace of mind. Can I get you on the calendar for next month?' This moves from passive 'call us if needed' to scheduled revenue and ensures the customer doesn't go dark.
